reviews.title: Old interface was better
reviews.text:
Update October 8, 2026:

Please bring back the simple UI and the old countdown clock until class. There’s too much stuff on the screen now and it’s distracting. Most of us serious learners want something simple and intuitive. This interface is not either of those. 

I have been using italki for over 10 years before they even had an app. I’ve never had any issues with any of the updates(except when they took away to ability to message and communicate with other learners) until  now. When I open it, the stupid AI chat seems to take up most of the screen and when I minimize it, it is still quite big. It’s more difficult to navigate overall. Not intuitive at all. I also don’t want to have to uncheck the “plus” option every time I search for tutors. The non-mobile version is also more complicated to navigate. Personally, I don’t like the new sidebar chat especially. I learn several languages as do many other italki users, in my opinion, we need more simplicity than extra stuff all over the screen. Please fix this :( 

Update: after reading some other user experiences in the reviews, I really agree with bgima …the whole AI thing should just be separate. In the language learning community itself, especially with us older ones, it’s really unenjoyable to have AI popping up everywhere. Especially in an app that we come to for real human interaction by taking classes. I have stayed using italki mostly because of the non-subscription based, freedom of flexible scheduling. People who really enjoy language learning will do it anyways, they don’t necessarily need to tie into a subscription to be more motivated. 

Update 2: I feel like every time I open the app, I find another inconvenience in the new interface and it’s very frustrating. I can’t seem to find the tutor reviews. I have not been able to see if I can find the tutor reviews on the non-mobile version yet. I also don’t like that when I check a tutor profile, the chat window in almost half the screen and it appears there’s some AI auto message from that tutor. All unnecessary clutter.

Please go back to the simple interface. This has really ruined my user experience.

reviews.title: The Best Language Learning App
reviews.text: Italki is wonderful. There are so many options as far as choices of instructors and price points. I found my perfect teacher after about five or six trail lessons with others. Actually, the others were all good but I connected more with one in particular and I’m very happy. Scheduling lessons is a snap. I get reminders about upcoming lessons and the Internet connection is reliable. I’m extremely happy with Italki.

reviews.title: Great resource
reviews.text: We do most of our classes via Zoom or Google meets, but the access to so many languages and language teachers at affordable rates is AMAZING. We have been using italki for 3 years and I am still impressed with the service it provides. I would love to see the platform offer new teachers, I think there could be more options but not sure if they limit it like many websites do.

reviews.title: Terrible👎👎👎
reviews.text: There aren't any good tutors here for under $30. They're unqualified and have no education!!! They're constantly rescheduling lessons!!!! And the app itself doesn't offer refunds!!!! I don't want to waste my money, and I still have $150 left in my account.

reviews.title: Great connecting native speakers / meh UI/UX
reviews.text: Fantastic at connecting native speakers A+. Sorry to say it plainly but the solo practice and exercises on the app are not good - the UX/UI stinks and when compared to the gamification, tests and quizzes to Quizlet and other apps, it doesn’t hold a flame. During speaking exercises it will tell me to “capitalize” certain words… I mean, how, it’s a speaking exercise. The format, experience, and process of the testing feels like it’s from the 90’s. Please take lessons from other apps and improve your AI, your practice and exercises, and the UI/UX.  If you’re just looking to connect and speaking with native speakers then this app is great.

reviews.title: Debit Card Payment
reviews.text: I want to use this platform, but italki literally will not take my money. Every single time I try to book a trial or a regular session, my payment fails.I have tried using my debit card directly, going through PayPal, and testing alternative payment methods. None of them work. My cards are completely fine and work everywhere else, so the issue is entirely on italki's end.It is incredibly frustrating to find a tutor you like, only to be blocked by a broken checkout system. If you cannot even process basic payments, you cannot run a functional service. Fix your system.

reviews.title: The site and app have gone downhill, support is a black hole
reviews.text: I’ve been taking lessons on italki since 2020. I had a complaint about how I feel they treated an amazing teacher of mine unfairly and prevented me from continuing my learning with him. I tried to register this complaint six or seven different ways. ZenDesk form, no confirmation. Support email, no answer. Support bot, claims I am being transferred to a human, human never arrives. Corporate email, nothing. I can’t so much as get an automated reply with a ticket number assigned. I’m beginning to question if any humans still work there. Do yourself a favor and use Preply instead.
